headline: Democratic Party's Yoon Jun-byeong Introduces 'Duty-Free Tariff Abuse Prevention Act'... 'Institutional Improvement Urgently Needed'
summary: Rep. Yoon Jun-byeong of the Democratic Party of Korea has introduced the Duty-Free Tariff Abuse Prevention Act. It targets intentional delayed exports of goods subject to quota tariffs.
why: Tariff quota rules set the duty rates on imports and exports, so changes to enforcement affect trade flows and costs for importers and exporters.
